results.rationale: Consistency: digits, wooden-stick appearance, blue heads and white background remain consistent outside the operator edits. Instruction: the operators become double-cross shapes while 14, 6 and 82 stay unchanged; extra strokes do not depict moving exactly two sticks to obtain a valid equation. Knowledge: Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: clean digit forms and uniform background are satisfactory, but malformed mathematical operators make the expression semantically incoherent.

Consistency: cat identity, pose and white fur are recognizable, but the fur texture is noticeably redrawn/coarsened. Instruction: bright pink Pet Home, gradient, paws and heart bubbles are present; cat size is reduced, and the tagline sits above the cat in white italic text on a pink bar instead of light-grey sans-serif below. Quality: cat and main lettering are coherent, but the decorative symbol at the tagline end and a broken pink shape near the tail are conspicuously malformed.
